headings.usage: Dashboard titles, metric numbers, empty states, H1-H4. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for larger sizes.

body.usage: Standard UI text, forms, logs descriptions, table data.

mono.usage: Memory search NLP query, API keys, timestamps, Webhook URLs, code blocks, live camera coordinates.

rules: Use Acid Green (#CCFF00) sparingly for live status dots, active states, and primary CTAs.
Do not use pure black (#000) for surfaces; use #050505 or #121212 to reduce OLED smearing.
Depth is created through lightness changes and 1px borders, NOT heavy drop shadows.

layouts.camera_wall: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 for dense viewing.
layouts.surface_treatment: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Heavy use of border-collapse and 1px subtle borders (border-[#262626]).
layouts.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or subtle (rounded-sm) for a brutalist technical feel.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise texture over the main background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glows: Subtle green drop-shadow on the pulsing 'Live' indicator dot (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)]).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers/floating bars (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/70 border-b border-[#262626]).
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Overlay a faint repeating-linear-gradient on camera thumbnails to mimic raw feeds.

components.cards: Flat background (#121212), 1px border (#262626), zero shadow. On hover: border brightens slightly.
components.buttons: Square edges, high contrast. Primary button: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-semibold.
components.inputs: Dark background (#050505), border (#262626). Focus ring: ring-1 ring-[#CCFF00].
components.memory_search: Prominent, command-palette style input, mono font, hinting at NLP ('Ask your cameras...').
components.badges: Flat colors. Red for alerts (bg-[#FF3366]/10 text-[#FF3366] border border-[#FF3366]/20).

motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200.
motion.feed: Staggered fade-in for event feed cards.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain WCAG AA (4.5:1). Never use low-opacity white text for primary reading.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus-visible rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

camera_feed_manufacturing.description: Industrial robotic arm - use for manufacturing quality control preview

camera_feed_gate.description: Secured industrial gate - use for trespasser/perimeter preview

event_snapshot_helmet.description: Yellow hard hat - use for PPE detection event snapshot

camera_hardware.description: Close up of security camera - use for onboarding/empty states

icons.instruction: Use Lucide React with technical precision (strokeWidth={1.5}).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a dark-first dashboard. Do NOT build a light mode toggle.
Inject the defined fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via @import in index.css.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove the 'Vercel-default' border-radius. Make them sharper and use the #262626 border color.
The Memory Search bar should be the centerpiece of the events page, feeling like a developer's CLI tool.
Use provided image URLs in camera cards and event timelines.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
Use recharts for analytics, styling lines with #CCFF00 and removing grid lines for a cleaner look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all).
NEVER center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Create depth using background lightness shifts, NOT shadows.
Use glass-morphism ONLY over scrolling content (like navbars), never over solid backgrounds.
Always use lucide-react icons; never use emojis as icons.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
